scope: Original in-memory protocol model with fictional source versions and verified-reference flags; no real connector, database, DSH, authentication or semantic resolver validation.

checks.name: N1 kind plus native ID collides for two repositories
N2 actor-only allowlist leaks permission between source instances
P1 four source instances retain same-number messages, threads and actors independently
P2 source-scoped Policy never borrows another instance actor permission
P3 payload source spoof and scope substitution cannot overwrite transport identity
P4 tuple encoding distinguishes delimiter-shaped native IDs
P5 retries ignore transport delivery IDs; edits retain immutable event history
P6 stale create/edit after deletion does not resurrect or authorize work
P7 same-version divergent content reports conflict without overwriting current
P8 editing an accepted message follows the same Ticket without new acceptance
P9 verified cross-channel reference records provenance without changing mandate
P10 similarity, ambiguous and invalid references never subscribe a Thread
P11 explicit reference is not permission and does not cross context Instances
P12 multi-owner handback blocks rerouting until every owner returns
P13 context-only and bot events cannot acquire human follow-up ownership
P14 replay after snapshot restore preserves dedup, namespace and handback
P15 legacy identifiers require an explicit unambiguous source mapping
